# FLOP Airdrop Skill
> Autonomous AI agent skill for $FLOP airdrop positioning and Flop Labs Technocore participation.

This repository provides instructions, scripts, and documentation allowing AI coding assistants and autonomous agent frameworks to guide users through the $FLOP airdrop without requiring coding skills.

## Core Documentation
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Complete autonomous execution instructions triggered by "Help me with the $FLOP airdrop".
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, 1-minute quick start (1-liner installer & npx skills), and framework compatibility.
- [docs/frameworks.md](docs/frameworks.md): Installation guides for Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
- [docs/article.md](docs/article.md): Complete educational publication and tutorial.
- [docs/contribution_templates.md](docs/contribution_templates.md): Ready-to-use humanized templates for X threads, blog posts, and public evidence.

## Automation Tools & Installers
- [install.ps1](install.ps1): 1-liner automated Windows PowerShell installer.
- [install.sh](install.sh): 1-liner automated macOS/Linux installer.
- [scripts/agent_toolkit.py](scripts/agent_toolkit.py): Automated tool for Ed25519 DID creation, encrypted key management, and Technocore room signing.
- [scripts/requirements.txt](scripts/requirements.txt): Minimal dependencies (`cryptography`).
